events.name: HackWithAditya 2026
events.what: Submit a working prototype (Level 1) as a team of 4–6 college students; shortlisted teams build at the finale.
events.desc: Online hackathon open to currently-enrolled Indian college/university students. Prototype screening, then a 3-day build.

events.name: KIIT 4th Hackathon 2027 (ICDCIT)
events.what: Submit a project proposal on rural-India challenges; shortlisted teams build on campus.
events.desc: National hackathon alongside the ICDCIT conference at KIIT. Proposal screening then finals.

events.name: Hoya Hacks 2027 — Georgetown
events.what: Apply and build at Georgetown's collegiate hackathon (listed on Devpost).
events.desc: College-focused US university hackathon, open to student hackers worldwide.
